description_zh: 新建专线网关ECR（Express Connect Router）
name: CreateExpressConnectRouter

parameters.help_en:
The name of the ECR instance.

The name can be empty or 0 to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with http\:// or https\://
parameters.help_zh:
专线网关实例的名称。
名称可以为空或长度为 0～128 个字符，不能以 http://或 https://开头
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the ECR instance.

The description can be empty or 0 to 256 characters in length. It cannot start with http\:// or https\://
parameters.help_zh:
专线网关实例的描述。

描述可以为空或长度为 0～256 个字符，不能以 http://或 https://开头
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the ECR instance belongs
parameters.help_zh: 专线网关实例所属的资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The autonomous system number (ASN) of the ECR instance. Valid values: 45104 (default), 64512 to 65534, and 4200000000 to 4294967294. The ASN 65025 is reserved for use by Alibaba Cloud
parameters.name: alibaba_side_asn

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: sends a check request without modifying service resources.

false (default): sends a normal request
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会修改服务资源。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a value from your client and make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The \`ClientToken\` parameter supports only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

fields.help_en: The tag key. The key cannot be an empty string. The key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 资源的标签键。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value. The value can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length, cannot start with `acs:`, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 监听的标签值。N的取值范围：1~20。一旦传入该值，可以为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The tags.

You can add up to 20 tags
parameters.help_zh:
标签。

最多可以绑定20个标签
parameters.name: tag

Code.description_en: The response code. A value of 200 indicates that the request was successful. For information about other error codes, see the "Error codes" section
Code.description_zh: 判断创建ECR实例是否成功。返回值为200表示创建成功，返回其他值表示创建失败，失败原因参见错误码

DynamicMessage.description_en:
The dynamic error message that is used to replace the `%s` placeholder in the \`Message\` parameter.

For example, if the value of Message is The value of input parameter %s is not valid. and the value of DynamicMessage is DtsJobId, the returned message is The value of input parameter DtsJobId is not valid
DynamicMessage.description_zh:
动态错误信息，用于替换返回参数ErrMessage错误信息中的`%s`。
如果ErrMessage返回The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid，且DynamicMessage返回DtsJobId，则代表所传入的请求参数DtsJobId不合法
DynamicMessage.example: The param format of Name **** is illegal.

EcrId.description_en: The ID of the ECR instance

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.

false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
创建ECR实例是否成功。取值：
true：成功。
false：失败
